findings.summary: The previous final review's two findings are fully resolved. (1) The receipt-read fault path at bridge.py:247-257 now re-raises BridgeStoreError instead of returning an action, and run_once catches it and breaks the loop, preventing a later message's seal from advancing the cursor past an unread decision; test_a_receipt_read_fault_mid_cycle_stops_the_loop pins this. (2) Both owner-side claim/act windows now detect interrupted claims and complete the recovery rather than reporting already_resumed for a never-performed resume: DdControlPlane.gate checks _generation_launched alongside the O_EXCL claim, and LineOwnerSource.resume wakes the parked line when a prior claim exists but the line is still parked; test_an_interrupted_claim_without_launch_is_completed and test_resume_completes_an_interrupted_claim pin both paths.
